private_reader_rules: Private only; no raw table/read/retype interface is emitted into user bodies. Caller cannot supply a ProgramView to public binding/session admission.

Validate exact out_bytes equals compiler sizeof selected element before copying. Reference/auth/read outputs remain unchanged on failure; work/first diagnostic reflect actually reserved preflight work.
Every candidate and byte is charged before inspection. Failure recording cannot recursively charge. Unknown pointers are compared only for exact equality with safe computed member starts.
Binding prepare copies fixed fields into a local view and publishes the view only after success; failure zeroes the destination view. A later open must call prepare afresh.
Rt8ReadState and diagnostic/work storage are immediate-use caller locals or current Context-owned state, never packet references, heap caches or admission credentials.

tick_rule.authority: CORE_FINAL_CONTRACT.md generalize/instantiate tick rule and B5; validation work is independently charged.

report_initialization.status: initially INTERNAL until a terminal result is recorded
report_initialization.nested_packet: zeroed until called; packet_checked explicitly distinguishes not-run; nested report is preserved unchanged after call
report_initialization.success: status OK, phase FINAL, detail NONE, all coordinates UINT32_MAX, binding_validated 1 only; actual counters and sizes populated

count_prechecks.all_count_gates: Before a count-controlled read/loop or extent calculation. Packet imposes its stricter exact Code+Site joint lower bound independently.

public_lifecycle_scope: Only declaration/runtime-source future decisions, not public lifecycle functions or fake types in Stage05A. Actual runtime options/report/Context/Node/Slot/Pending/Frame definitions and session implementation require the next complete source-review gate.

label_policy.contents: Every emitted textual helper/record operand, including SSA diagnostics and Rt8FactoryCapture.name. Include/count strings also present in packet.
label_policy.ordering: Deduplicate exact UTF-8 byte sequences, then strict unsigned-byte lexical order; offset index follows that order.
label_policy.forbidden: First-encounter order, hidden C string literals, packet-string fallback, names used to guess Code/Site identity.
label_policy.factory_capture_name: Validate against already-selected Code capture row/position; obtain using rt8_label.

diagnostic_initialization: Private Rt8Diagnostic starts OK/NONE with absent coordinates. Public report starts INTERNAL until terminal result; first private failure is copied into report exactly once. Report initialization is not treated as an existing failure.
ctx_failure_transfer: Ctx accessor/instruction helper failure poisons and transfers non-returningly to the enclosing installed active session fault boundary. No NULL/error-return continuation and no emitter status polling. Successful void/pointer returns retain documented semantics. No-Context binding/reader functions return numeric status; eventual ctx wrappers convert non-OK to non-returning fault. Valid active sequential context is a precondition.
